title: rubus ulmifolius var. peracutispinus
intro: Rubus ulmifolius var. peracutispinus, commonly known as a variety of the Elm-leaved Blackberry, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Rubus ulmifolius var. peracutispinus include its use as an antidiarrheal, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, supporting the treatment of gastrointestinal issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
